facts.business: Ranjit Securities Limited is a Non-Deposit Taking Non-Systemically Important Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) primarily engaged in investment activities and lending.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company does not foresee any substantial changes in its business and profitability in the coming year.

key_risks: Investments in selected companies with no stock market available for liquidity
Dependence on realization of investments and loans for growth
facts.related_party_note: The Company has not provided any guarantees or security or investment. For particulars of loans given and investments made pursuant to Section 186 of the Companies Act, 2013, refer to relevant notes in the financial statements.
